title: Spider
wikitext:
[[image:spiders.png|thumb|A spider and a tarantula.]]

Though many scholars believe that all spiders trace their roots back to the ancient kingdom of [[Azjol-Nerub]], the giant spiders of [[Kalimdor]] have made a claim to the shadowy corners of [[Ashenvale]] Forest. Though not necessarily evil, wild spiders can become fearsome opponents if they feel their nests have been defiled. They are found in [[Tirisfal Glades]], the [[Burning Steppes]], [[Teldrassil]], [[Ashenvale]], the [[Redridge Mountains]], [[Loch Modan]], [[Duskwood]], the [[Wetlands]], the [[Stonetalon Mountains]], the [[Western Plaguelands]], [[Silverpine Forest]], the [[Hillsbrad Foothills]], [[Azshara]], [[Blackrock Depths]], [[Blackrock Spire]], [[Silithus]], the [[Swamp of Sorrows]], the [[Arathi Highlands]], the [[Searing Gorge]], [[Dustwallow Marsh]], and [[Zul'Gurub]].

During the [[First War]], Orc Warlocks were adept at summoning these creatures to fight for the Horde.

Spiders are fond of using poison spit and throwing webs upon opponents.  There are three different models of spider: tarantula; and a much larger version of a normal spider; and a miniature spider. The [[Smoulderweb Hatchling]], a miniature spider, can be obtained as a small pet.

*Not skinnable.
*Usually drop webbing, spider legs, spinnerets, mandibles (or fangs), or spider meat as loot.

== As A [[Hunter]] Pet ==
* Has high damage, medium HP, and low armor.
* Eats only Meat.  
* Can learn Cower, Growl, and Bite.  They have yet to recieve their species skill.
* The Spire Spiderling of Lower Blackrock Spire has a fast 1.5 attack speed.
* Spiders are not very popular as Hunter pets.
